tldr: Jupiter through the 8th house expands shared money, trust, intimacy, dependency, and control.
body:
When Jupiter moves through your 8th house, it makes more room around shared money, debt, trust, intimacy, dependency, fear, grief, and what is hard to control. You may notice where trust, money, attachment, or vulnerability is carrying more weight than usual.

Hope, appetite, confidence, opportunity, and risk can all get bigger. It can help you say yes to something that gives your life more range.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for getting honest about what is shared, owed, feared, or avoided.

The caution: Watch for taking on more than the situation, your schedule, or your judgment can hold. The risk is trying to control what actually needs a clearer agreement or a more truthful conversation.

Jupiter moves through this house for about a year. Let the opening be real, but keep your promises sized to the life you can actually live.
